body:
🤖 Implemented the experimental manifest planner/local handoff at [ac13a420](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/commit/ac13a420); [result checkpoint 07d0324c](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/07d0324c/experiments/48-generation-manifest/results.md) preserves the exact local evidence.

- Configs, full frozen PR descriptors, source/dependencies, notices/eligibility, backend/profile, budget/archive and fixed run IDs are inputs. The original adapter/runtime files are reused unchanged. Fresh versus consume-completed generation is explicit; no per-repository Python edit or added model repair.
- [41 integrated checks](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/07d0324c/experiments/48-generation-manifest/local-checks/integrated-001/output.txt) passed in 7.03s, peak RSS 60,864 KiB. Nineteen wrapper cases cover multiple repositories/candidates, empty output, changed inputs/settings, interrupted planning, inert resume and serial holds. Twenty-two original runtime checks cover request/secret guards, unknown billing, zero attempts, uncertain submission and seven lifecycle interruptions. Repository fixtures are synthetic interface tests, not discovered PR coverage.
- [Actual archived-source proof](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/07d0324c/experiments/48-generation-manifest/archived-proof.json): consume completed #45 only, with network/subprocess/credential reads globally forbidden. One known PR1497 local export; repeated advance byte-inert; all 191 original generation files and shared global budget unchanged. [Ten-member parity](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/07d0324c/experiments/48-generation-manifest/archived-output-parity.json) preserves all modes, Dockerfile, eight other assets and semantic grading; only native TOML reproducibility metadata differs.
- No controls were rerun, no new model/job/spend, no new unique task and no new scientific acceptance. Default native emitter/verifier remain unchanged, so the earlier baseline reconstruction failure remains. The APT experiment and late rewards were not silently applied or accepted.

The [research interface and limitations](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/07d0324c/experiments/48-generation-manifest/README.md) distinguish preparation, execution and acceptance. Supported packaging/acquisition and a fresh manifest-path execution are still required. [Cleanup record](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/07d0324c/experiments/48-generation-manifest/local-cleanup.json): removed this turn’s three synthetic scratch trees; retained 1.17 MB of exact archived-handoff output for extraction parity/review. No task-owned `/tmp` files or active job/controller. Original traces remain in previously verified HF snapshots; this small metadata is permanent Git evidence. Issue and epic stay open; no next native/model admission or automatic merge.
